# AppTitle

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AppTitle:Void title:String, close_prompt:String=\
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | In | String | required | The window title. |
| `close_prompt` | In | String | `\` | The question the original asked before closing the window. |

## Description

Sets the title of the program window.

## Differences

* It works before or after [Graphics](Graphics) alike: a title set before the window exists names the window when it is made, and one set later renames it. Until a program sets a title, the window is called `BlitzLLVM`. The question is asked when somebody closes the window. If they cancel, the program carries on; otherwise the window closes as it would have without the question.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
AppTitle "My game"
```
